command_args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to glmark2-es2-wayland. Each item must be a string matching a valid CLI option or argument.

benchmark.description: List of benchmark specifications (e.g., 'shading:duration=5.0') to use with '-b'. May include default-option prefixes starting with ':'.

benchmark_file.description: List of paths to benchmark description files to use with '--benchmark-file'.

validate.description: If true, run a quick output validation test instead of benchmarks (adds '--validate').

data_path.description: Path to glmark2 models, shaders and textures (maps to '--data-path').

off_screen.description: If true, render to an off-screen surface (adds '--off-screen').

reuse_context.description: If true, use a single context for all scenes (adds '--reuse-context').

size.description: Window size WxH, e.g., '1920x1080', or '-1x-1' for fullscreen (maps to '-s/--size').

fullscreen.description: If true, run in fullscreen mode (adds '--fullscreen', overrides --size).

results.description: Colon-separated list of result types: 'fps', 'cpu', or 'shader' (maps to '--results').

results_file.description: Path to file to save results (maps to '--results-file'). Extension determines format (e.g., '.csv', '.xml').

winsys_options.description: Colon-separated window system options, e.g., 'gl-api=es2' (maps to '--winsys-options').

list_scenes.description: If true, display available scenes and their options (adds '-l/--list-scenes').

show_all_options.description: If true, show all scene option values used (adds '--show-all-options').

run_forever.description: If true, run indefinitely looping through benchmarks (adds '--run-forever').

annotate.description: If true, annotate with on-screen info (adds '--annotate').
